context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements a Docusaurus lifecycle plugin: plugin structure with a name property and lifecycle hooks, use of setGlobalData/addRoute/createData in contentLoaded, injectHtmlTags returning headTags, getClientModules pointing to a client module, onRouteUpdate exported from the client module, validateOptions using Joi from @docusaurus/utils-validation, and correct peerDependency declaration for @docusaurus/core.

checklist.name: Plugin name property
checklist.description: The plugin's returned object has a `name` property (e.g. `name: 'docusaurus-plugin-team'` or similar string)

checklist.name: loadContent reads file
checklist.description: The plugin implements a `loadContent()` lifecycle hook that reads or fetches the team data file (uses fs.readFile, require, or similar file I/O)

checklist.name: contentLoaded destructures actions
checklist.description: The `contentLoaded({ content, actions })` hook destructures at least `setGlobalData`, `addRoute`, and `createData` from the `actions` parameter

checklist.name: setGlobalData called
checklist.description: The plugin calls `setGlobalData(...)` inside `contentLoaded` to expose team data globally

checklist.name: addRoute called
checklist.description: The plugin calls `addRoute(...)` at least once inside `contentLoaded` to register a team-related route

checklist.name: createData called
checklist.description: The plugin calls `createData(...)` inside `contentLoaded` and uses the returned path in an `addRoute` call

checklist.name: injectHtmlTags hook present
checklist.description: The plugin implements `injectHtmlTags()` and returns an object with a `headTags` array containing at least one tag (e.g. a preconnect `link` tag)

checklist.name: getClientModules returns path
checklist.description: The plugin implements `getClientModules()` and returns an array containing a path to `clientModule.js` (using `path.resolve` or equivalent)

checklist.name: onRouteUpdate exported
checklist.description: `clientModule.js` exports a function named `onRouteUpdate` (e.g. `export function onRouteUpdate(...)` or `exports.onRouteUpdate = ...`)

checklist.name: validateOptions uses Joi
checklist.description: The plugin exports a `validateOptions` function that imports `Joi` from `@docusaurus/utils-validation` and uses `Joi.object(...)` to define a schema

checklist.name: No @docusaurus/core in dependencies
checklist.description: `package.json` does NOT list `@docusaurus/core` under the `dependencies` field
